name: ax-vscode
description: Guided zero-to-sandbox setup for Agent Substrate & AX, one-click CLI + agent skill installation, ax.io/v1alpha1 schema diagnostics, and sandboxed Task, Workspace, Gateway, and Model management.

walkthroughs.title: Set Up AX & Agent Substrate
walkthroughs.description: Go from a clean machine with zero AX tooling to running isolated gVisor agent sandboxes in 4 guided steps.

steps.title: 1. Install ax CLI & Agent Skills
steps.description:
Install ~/.ax/bin/ax into VS Code's terminal PATH and sync the AX coding-agent skill to ~/.agents, ~/.claude, and ~/.gemini.
[Install / Verify CLI & Skills](command:ax.installCliAndSkills)

steps.title: 2. Official AX Release Images (Pre-Configured)
steps.description:
Pre-configured to pull official @sha256-pinned v0.4.0-rc.1 images from ghcr.io/google/ax with zero local build.
[Switch Release or Custom Images](command:ax.prepareImages)

steps.title: 3. Bootstrap Agent Substrate & Deploy AX
steps.description:
Provision the local Kubernetes 1.36+ Kind cluster, install Agent Substrate v1.0.0 + gVisor WorkerPool, and deploy ax-postgres + ax-server.
[Bootstrap Local Stack](command:ax.localStart)

steps.title: 4. Add Egress Credential Secret & Run a Task
steps.description:
Store your LLM API key as a labeled Kubernetes Secret for zero-trust Gateway injection, then scaffold and run a sandboxed Task.
[Configure Credential Secret](command:ax.configureCredentialSecret)
[New Task / PR Review Manifest](command:ax.newTaskManifest)

languageModelTools.name: ax_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect AX CLI version, full 6-step setup readiness, local Kind + Agent Substrate + AX stack health (`ax local status -o json`), container runtime readiness, and active Kubernetes contexts/tunnels (`ax ctx`). Call this first before creating or managing AX tasks.

localClusterName.description: Optional local cluster name for `ax local status` (defaults to ax-local).

languageModelTools.name: ax_list_resources
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List AX `tasks`, `workspaces`, `gateways`, or `models` in the configured cluster context and atespace.

atespace.description: Optional atespace override (defaults to configured `ax.atespace` or `default`).

languageModelTools.name: ax_manage_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply an `ax.io/v1alpha1` YAML manifest (`apply`), or `resume`, `suspend`, `describe`, or `delete` an AX resource (`task`, `workspace`, `gateway`, `model`). Remember: newly applied Tasks start `Suspended` and require `resume` to execute.

manifestYaml.description: YAML manifest text to submit when `action` is `apply`.

kind.description: Resource kind for `describe` or `delete` (defaults to `task` for `resume`/`suspend`).

languageModelTools.name: ax_ssh_exec
languageModelTools.displayName: Execute Command in AX Task Sandbox
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a non-interactive command inside a `Working` or `Completed` AX Task sandbox (`ax ssh <task> -- sh -c <command>`). Requires `spec.debug: true` on the Task.

taskName.description: Name of the Working AX task.

command.description: Shell command executed via `sh -c` inside the task sandbox.

ax.autoInstallCliAndSkills.description: Automatically install the bundled `ax` CLI binary to `~/.ax/bin` (and add to VS Code terminal PATH) and sync the `ax` agent skill to `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.gemini/skills`, and `~/.gemini/config/skills` (Antigravity) on startup.

ax.promptGuidedSetupOnStartup.description: Prompt to launch the AX Guided Setup Wizard on startup when Agent Substrate or AX Control Plane is not yet installed.

ax.installDir.description: Custom directory where the bundled `ax` binary is installed (defaults to `~/.ax/bin`).

ax.skillHomeDir.description: Optional home directory override where `.agents/skills`, `.claude/skills`, and `.gemini/skills` are synced (defaults to user home `~`).

ax.releaseVersion.description: Official `google/ax` GitHub release tag used for AX container image defaults.

ax.serverImage.description: Container image reference (`repo:tag` or `repo@sha256:...`) passed as `--server-image` to `ax local start` and `ax install` (defaults to official `v0.4.0-rc.1` GHCR release).

ax.defaultTaskImage.description: Default sandbox task container image (`--default-task-image`) used when a Task omits `spec.profile.image` (defaults to official `v0.4.0-rc.1` GHCR release).

ax.runnerVolumeImage.description: Optional runner volume container image (`--runner-volume-image`) mounted read-only into task containers (defaults to official `v0.4.0-rc.1` GHCR release).

ax.localWorkers.description: Number of gVisor worker replicas (`--workers`) deployed by `ax local start`.

ax.autoRefreshIntervalSeconds.description: Live auto-refresh interval (in seconds) while the AX Explorer sidebar is visible so tasks created by CLI coding agents appear automatically (`0` disables polling).

ax.atespace.description: Default AX atespace (`-a` / `--atespace`) for listing and managing resources.

ax.context.description: Optional Kubernetes context override (`--context`). Empty uses the active kubeconfig current-context.

ax.kubeconfig.description: Optional path to a custom kubeconfig file (`KUBECONFIG`) passed to `ax` commands.

ax.server.description: Optional explicit `ax-server` address (`--server`), bypassing automatic Kubernetes tunneling.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:ax && npm run compile && node ./dist/test/e2e/runE2E.js
scripts.package: npm run build:ax && npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-git-tag-version -o ax-vscode.vsix
